messages:
eve: Heads-upI'm opening a micro-PR to refresh the 'hello-sprint' quickstart. Goals: swap inline token examples for .env usage, replace Dockerfile with a multi-stage build, add a tiny GH Actions secrets example, and a short "do not commit credentials" callout. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5128

jon: Nice. Can you paste the new Dockerfile and the .env example here so I can scan them quickly?

eve: Dockerfile below (keeps app code unchanged):

```dockerfile
# stage 1: deps
FROM python:3.11-slim AS builder
WORKDIR /build
COPY pyproject.toml requirements.txt ./
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt -t /build/.deps

# stage 2: runtime
FROM python:3.11-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=builder /build/.deps /app/.deps
COPY --chown=1000:1000 . /app
ENV PYTHONPATH=/app/.deps:/app
CMD ["python", "app.py"]
```

.env example (do NOT commit):
```
REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk-REDACTED_EXAMPLE
```

ravi: Good. Add a one-liner for local testing (`export REDWOOD_API_KEY=...`) and a short GH Actions secret example so readers know how to set it in CI.

eve: Added both to the PR. GH Actions snippet in docs: `echo \"$REDWOOD_API_KEY\" | gh secret set REDWOOD_API_KEY` and an example workflow showing how to reference the secret.

jon: Double-check the SDK snippet uses the current pattern. Use `client.generate()` and avoid old helpers. Which form are you showing in the quickstart?

eve: Using `client.generate(model=\"redwood-alpha\", input=prompt)` in the example — mocked during smoke tests. Also added a note about batching for throughput-sensitive apps.

ravi: Minor edit request: add a short callout under "When to use Dedicated" something like: "For sustained >10 req/s or high concurrency, consider Redwood Dedicated or batching" pointing to /docs/dedicated/overview.

eve: Added the callout and link. Also replaced any `echo $TOKEN` examples with `printf '***'` placeholders to avoid accidental exposure.

link-checker: Running link-check on changed files... Found one outdated internal link in docs/quickstarts/hello-sprint.md -> ./auth-old.md. Suggested replacement: ../auth/overview.md

eve: Patched the link in the branch.

ci-bot: CI started: lint, link-check, secret-scan. Secret-scan: no secrets found in diffs. Link-check: warnings resolved.

jon: Quick editorial pass: two tiny wording nits around "local dev" phrasing. Nothing blocking.

eve: Fixed wording. Will merge after CI is green and will backport to the next release branch. Ping here for follow-ups. :rocket:
